    • getSessionUser

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/bff/user", produces="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<SessionUserResponse> getSessionUser()
      GET /bff/user : Returns the signed-in user Answers the user signed in to the BFF session, as UI-safe claims of its ID token. Tokens are never part of the response: they stay on the server.
      Returns:
      The signed-in user (status code 200) or There is no signed-in user (status code 401)
